description: The levee-aware scripts calculate storage for natural and leveed conditions and downscale simulated flood volumes to one-arcsecond depths within a user-specified bounding box. This resource is provided by Aslam, Muhammad Hasnain. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The release describes a research workflow; numerical performance and dependency installation were not tested. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
